item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera's school in Pune wants to help protect life on Earth. Some students say that one big action, such as recycling plastic bottles, is enough on its own. Which statement about protecting life on Earth is correct?

options.A: Life is protected only when many connected actions are taken together, such as cutting pollution, saving energy and water, and protecting biodiversity, because Earth's systems affect one another.
options.B: Recycling plastic alone is enough to protect all of Earth's life-supporting systems.
options.C: Earth's atmosphere, water, land, and living things are separate, so an action in one system cannot affect the others.
options.D: Only governments can protect life on Earth, so individual and community actions make no difference.
